title: ChatGPT was a chatbot.  Now it has its own computer.
description:
ChatGPT was a chatbot. Now it has its own computer.
With ChatGPT Work it opens a cloud browser, hits a login screen, pauses, and hands you a secure sign-in — credentials go straight to the browser, never to the model.
Then it finishes the task while your phone is in your pocket.
Download it here: https://chatgpt.com/download/
